payload.title: Resilience: one malformed issue file must not make every board command fail
payload.description:
One issue file with a bad dependencies entry (a bare string where a DependencyLink object is expected) makes every command that loads all issues fail (kbs list, show, update, create) on a real board (AnthusAI/Chatticus, kbs 0.36.0).

Exact error from kbs list/show/update/create:
Error: invalid type: string "chatticus-0d9b9f84-6940-4e36-ad37-13b0e9bf0850", expected struct DependencyLink
(this text does not name the offending file or field).

kbs validate does name it: "chatticus-602a25a2-9332-493e-8589-14520853d1fa.json: invalid issue data: invalid type: string ..., expected struct DependencyLink".

Gaps: (1) the loader is all-or-nothing, so one bad record bricks the board; (2) kbs repair only recreates missing directories and guard files (rust/src/file_io.rs repair_project_structure), it cannot fix or quarantine a bad record; (3) kbs doctor is environment diagnostics only; (4) docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md "Malformed JSON in an issue file" tells users to open and edit the file by hand, which contradicts the rule never to hand-edit project/issues.

Proposed: loaders skip-and-report malformed records (warning naming file and field) for read and write commands, with a strict flag for CI; add kbs doctor --fix or kbs repair --issues that quarantines or normalizes bad records (for example a bare string dependency to {target, type: blocked-by}); include the filename in the load error.
